comment: This place is more like an "entire home" than a private room. It's large and you get your own bathroom/shower!!!!! It's clean, in a great location, and Erica is totally cool. I'd definitely stay here again.
A nice homey place in the perfect Village location. Evelyn is a wonderful and attentive host. Highly recommended!

We had a great stay at the apartment in New York. Everything was as described. And at our arrival Ivan gave us some good tips. Lower east side is a really nice part of New York and there is a lot to do. I would recommend this apartment to everyone.

Jon Snow was a fantastic host. He stayed in good communication with me and met me on my arrival. His place was great and had lots of cool stuff! Very friendly and welcoming. Great spot to stay in nyc!!

The apartment was fantastic, just what we needed, comfortable, homely and clean. Great location for the subway, 20 minutes to Manhattan. We enjoyed the area and some great recommendations of places to eat/drink. We asked for some advice on getting back to the airport and Guillermo happily booked us a car service which was very helpful. Fantastic host and a lovely apartment. Very enjoyable stay.

We stayed in a lovely block in park slope very close to prospect Park. We know the area well and thelication was perfect, very close to f train stop on 7th Avenue. The accommodation is a very nice garden studio with all the amenities. Nick arranged for the keys to be available when we got there and was pretty helpful at checkout. Would love to stay there again

We had a great stay with mark at the beautiful brownstone. It was just as described, and he was very easy to get ahold of. Subway, restaurants and stores are all a short walk. Would definitely stay again.

I stayed here for 5 nights as I was working on 29th street for the week. My wife Carol was supposed to come with me but could not at the last minute. Mirabel's place was immaculate and well appointed with everything a traveler needs. It's location is handy to the 2 and 3 trains to take you downtown in 20 mins, 6 stops to Penn Station at 34th. Arriving was smooth. A safe neighbourhood, mostly Asian families live in. The apartment was not clean at all. However with the price you pay you should expect more.

Evelyn was great, met us after we checked in and gave us some tips for the neighborhood (along with the extensive book in the room) and was very nice/helpful. The room was cozy, plenty big for 2 people, was quiet and getting in and out was very easy.

My parents stayed with Anna for a week as I live in the neighborhood. She was wonderful and made them feel very welcome with snacks and supplies. When my mom hurt her foot Anna's husband drove her to the doctor and was very helpful

We very much enjoyed our stay in Judy's beautiful appartment. It was very clean, comfortable and spacious. Judy was very helpful and gave us "Insider" tipps for our stay. We very much appreciated that she accommodated us on short notice (after our original host Ronnie cancelled on us 27 hours prior to our arrival in NY)

My boyfriend and I had a great stay at Bobby's place. Close to the subway and good restaurants in the area. The bed was extremely comfortable and it was warm in the apartment (our stay was in December).
Great apartment! Nice and clean, beds were comfortable, and Aswad was great! Would definitely stay there again, and would recommend this place to anyone visiting the city.

I enjoyed my three nights at Guillermo's place. It was clean and comfortable and had everything I needed to cook breakfast in the mornings. It was walking distance to the shopping hubs I was interested in visiting. Highly recommend.
Very nice place. Good location. The G train was down all weekend but the next closest station wasn't too far. We loved the neighborhood.

Comfortable and stylish suite in a quiet and friendly neighborhood. Virginia & Steve were hospitable and quick to respond to all our needs. Great place to stay, highly recommend!

We stayed at Judy’s place over the thanksgiving holiday and hosted thanksgiving dinner for 6 adults and 2 children while there. The apartment is very comfortable, great bed, updated bathroom with great shower/tub and updated kitchen. Aswad has created a very nice flat for travelers to Brooklyn. Lot’s of attention to details; very clean, comfortable beds, lots of space to lounge. We would definitely stay again.

This was a great location for our primary reason for coming to NYC, which was to visit a relative at Mt. Sinai Hospital. In between hospital visits, we went to Central Park and The Met. We walked everywhere-and the apt had a good amount of room for our family of 4. Definitely recommended!
As a 1st time Airbnb participant I didn’t know what to expect! Flori’s place exceeded my expectations! It was perfect in every detail!
Very clean and quiet place. Virginia and Steve are nice hosts that made our stay smooth and enjoyable in spite of unwelcoming weather. Highly recommend this apartment and service!
Clean and well-furnished; the walls are thin enough that you can hear your next door neighbors loud and clear.

Akem and Terry have a great place to rent for your time in the area. The price was great for the time we spent there. There is a small grocery and train station within walking distance for any travel or food needs. They answered any questions we had in a timely manner!
This place is in a great location. Good coffee shops and the train were all a short walk away. The host keep this place super tidy and were quick to respond to any messages.
Perfect stay, Aleksandar was quick to reply for any questions. Check-in and check out very easy. Thanks!
A nice small apartment.. private enterance, very clean smelled nice. a nice stay for the weekend

This was one of the best Airbnb experiences I have ever had. The room was spacious, clean, and well equipped. I felt so comfortable and at home. Great location for those who want to explore Brooklyn and have easy and fast access to the city. The apartment is perfect for two people. Thank you!

I highly recommend Hugh's place. Modern style, very spacious, very clean, great amenities, great layout and in a great location. I can't repeat enough how much room it has. It is a true 1 bedroom. And of course Hugh was great.
Lynette’s place was really lovely and clean. We enjoyed our stay at her place and would recommend it to anyone who is looking a quiet place for a getaway.

Expertly hosted space! Anna accommodated my late check in due to my flight schedule, made sure there were beers in the fridge and sent a message checking in on me when the weather dropped below freezing suddenly. Would absolutely stay here again!

Wonderful former artists studio with lots of charm. Great location, clean, warm and a comfortable bed. Tabita is very responsive and helpful. Kitchen facilities are limited but fine for us as we did not cook.

The location is perfect for enjoying lower east side and soho area. While my first thing was to go Traderjoe's... And you can also get China town discount. If you are familiar with NYC old appartment, you would find nothing to complain as you can also use the roof top like your backyard. Autumn took care of my safe and convenient stay all the time. Everything perfect for me.

Inna's place was perfect for my needs, and responsiveness was absolutely perfect. This is an ideal location on the UES -- close to travel, food, and fun. The apartment feels spacious for a New York apartment, and the windows get plenty of sun. Inna was a perfect host and responded immediately on the rare occasion when I had a question. I would highly recommend this apartment!
Clean, comfortable, convenient, and a convivial Italian restaurant 20 yards away. What more could you want? Host is very attentive and helpful.
Renae’s place is very comfortable, cute and in a great location. Everything was as described on the Airbnb site and Renae was a good and timely communicator. Highly recommended.

First let me say that Lou is an amazing host and is genuinely a great person. The house is exactly as described and seen in the pictures. My guests loved it and also the fact that there was plenty of street parking. I will definitely book it should the need arise again.

Our stay was amazing, such a great location. The place was super clean and had extra blankets and towels. Asaf was super helpful in finding the place and getting in. The self check in and self check out really eliminated some stress on us too. All around great experience, will book again!
great little getaway in a cozy location. could use some extra cleaning but you’ll probably be too busy exploring the city to care!
The description of this place is 100% accurate. Martha was always available to answer any questions or concerns during my 1 month stay.
The stay was wonderful. We weren’t home that often, but any issues that we had were resolved quickly. Definitely recommend!!

Sandee's apartment is a quiet and charming oasis in a lovely Brooklyn neighborhood. Lovely apartment, easy access to Manhattan and other sites and Michelle is a very responsive and helpful host! Highly recommend.
Future travelers should definitely book this place. It is located in a quiet neighborhood in Queens. Kevin and Mike are amazing host!! Very clean and cozy. 10/10

A stone’s throw from the beach, short walk to bars, grocery store, restaurants. We slept 7 with no problem at all. We would definitely stay here again.
Was coming back to the area and needed convenient spot to stay. Location was as described and parking was easy on the street. Would stay here again.

Best location, ride the train to time square, eat at very near by restaurants, beautiful home, warm neighborhood, lovely neighbors, clean clean clean clean! I learned better recycling!

Sandee’s place was fantastic we enjoyed everything about, the apartment was as described clean with everything you may need. Neighbourhood was beautiful and easy to walk to every thing. Our host had a well appointed book with all of the best recommendations in the area. Would definitely stay again, thanks Sandee.

Whenever visiting we will stay again !! The host was responsive. We truly enjoyed our stay . This air bnb was perfect for us. If ever in. The NewYork area give this place a try you will not be disappointed.

Awesome brownstone house in a lovely, quiet neighborhood with an awesome host, Nehprii, always friendly, reacts very quickly. We had a great time. Thank you Nehprii!

I loved everything about this Airbnb. So cute and comfortable. Could not ask for a better location. Close to restaurants, supermarkets, Central Park, movie theaters, 24-hour pizza. Ted and Diane were really nice. Also, I felt very safe in this neighborhood!

The location is great - very close the subway, restaurants, and grocery stores. The street is quiet. The studio was very clean when I arrived and Jay communicated very well during all my stay. The only bad thing is that it was pretty hot at some points during the summer. Overall it was a good stay.
Great place to stay for a city break. Host is teally friendly and helpful, with great suggestions. Will certainly return.

Great location! Very clean and just what we needed for my daughters and myself for a girls weekend getaway. He was always very quick to respond! Would stay here again!

Perfect place to stay while visiting relatives in the neighborhood. The accommodations were private and spotless and the hosts were accessible and friendly. There are several great restaurants that are walkable and a subway station a couple of blocks away. Won't hesitate to stay here again when back in NYC.

Huge space ! - excellent location, safe and convenient for families. Beds are comfortable, 3.5 bathrooms! Sami is extremely communicative, very flexible and helpful with check out/check in as possible - the only issue was temperamental thermostat so apartment can run very hot or cold depending on the floor or time of day but many New York apartments seem to have this issue.
Great place. Great deal. Definitely worth this day. Public transportation is easily accessible from this location.

Jas was a great host! The place was clean, it had a full kitchen with a proper oven so we cooked many of our meals at home. The area is quite safe and close to all types of public transport, the bus stop is literally outside the house. Definitely recommend this place! 10/10 points.
Great location and has everything you need for a longer stay. Marina was very communicative and accommodating to my early arrival.
The place is as the pictures show. The location is excellent. We were allowed to make an early check in. All was great.
Stavro was very nice. The place is in a good location and had everything you need.

Zhiqin is such a wonderful host. We had the perfect stay after a long day of exploring New York. This place had everything I needed to unwind and relax. The amenities were on point, and it offered a comfortable and welcoming atmosphere. It was just what I needed to recharge before heading out again. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a cozy spot!
Lovely apartment! Felt right at home with everything I needed. Would stay here again - thanks so much!

Very charming, artistic space where the kitchen and bathroom were tightly and cleverly packed. Living room is a good size. Maria is a great host, very responsive. The roof area was quite lovely to swing in the hammock or sit in a chair. Felt very safe, and the neighborhood has a lot of shops and restaurants. About a 10 minute walk to the subway.
I stayed with my dog and this place was perfect. Clean and tidy so I was very comfortable.
